description: Production-grade, stack-agnostic multi-agent orchestration system with structured memory, skill registry, self-correcting workflows, and deterministic hook-enforced guardrails (git/database/secrets).
paths_note: Every bare path referenced anywhere in this system (memory/root.md, context/root.md, doc/*.md, skills/*, credentials/credentials.md, security/guardrails.md, tools/*) is relative to .claude/ at the project root, e.g. memory/root.md means .claude/memory/root.md.

hooks.note: Deterministic enforcement backstop for the same rules stated in CLAUDE.md and security/guardrails.md. Prompt rules can be misread; hooks fail closed.

mode.note: Detection runs first and sets mode. new_project = no real stack manifest found -> ask core_questions, extended_questions default to [TBD], run the design_direction step (3 mockups). existing_project = a stack manifest exists -> ask ONLY name + description; auto-accept stack, database+schema, file_structure, deployment, auth, testing, and the full design-token system from detection; agents+skills get defaults; the only interruption is the ambiguity_gate. Print an auto-accept summary for one-reply correction.
mode.existing_project: ask name + description only; everything else auto-accepted from detection; ambiguity_gate for genuine blockers; opt-out phrase 'let me confirm each' -> run the new_project-style confirm-each flow

ambiguity_gate.note: existing_project only. One targeted AskUserQuestion per unresolved blocker, and only if it fired. Otherwise zero questions beyond name + description.
blockers: two conflicting framework signals at one root in a non-monorepo
backend/API code present but zero database signal
more than one distinct design-token system with no clear canonical one (a clearly-scoped landing-vs-app split is recorded, not asked)
a manifest / schema / config that will not parse

core_questions.asked_when: both modes (existing_project: pre-filled from detection, Enter accepts)

core_questions.prompt: One sentence: what does this site do? — then, optionally, one line for primary goal + anything out of scope (enter to skip).
core_questions.asked_when: both modes (never detectable — the only thing existing_project asks besides name)
new_project only. existing_project: auto-accepted from detection (framework + major version + language + package manager); a question only if the ambiguity_gate fires.

options.label: Other
options.note: auto-added by AskUserQuestion; free text e.g. 'Nuxt / Laravel / MySQL', 'Astro', 'SvelteKit'

core_questions.detect: next.config.* -> nextjs; vite.config.* + react dep -> react-vite; artisan -> Laravel + version; manage.py -> Django; a Vue/Svelte/Nuxt manifest -> that framework

core_questions.asked_when: new_project only. existing_project: auto-accepted from detection + full schema enumeration; a question only if backend/API code exists but no DB signal (ambiguity_gate).

options.label: Other
options.note: auto-added; e.g. SQLite, Supabase, PlanetScale, DynamoDB

core_questions.detect: prisma provider / config/database.* / docker-compose db image / driver dep (pg, mysql2, mongoose) / .env.example DB_CONNECTION (NEVER .env)
frontend_only_effects: doc/project-overview.md#architecture = 'Frontend-only — no database / backend data layer'

core_questions.prompt: Brand name, and a primary color + tone if you have one (else just the name).
core_questions.required: when any of odin/vision is active
core_questions.asked_when: new_project only (Part 1). existing_project: not asked — name from the name question, primary color + full token system from detection, tone inferred from the description.
core_questions.detect: name; primary color + the whole token system (tailwind theme, :root/.dark custom properties, CVA maps in **/ui/*, ui/* primitives that exist, font links); logo/favicon/og paths
core_questions.design_direction: runs in the design_direction step after the agent set is known
core_questions.skip_when: no UI agent (odin/vision) active -> doc/brandpack.md not generated

core_questions.asked_when: new_project only. existing_project: all optional agents on (defaults), disclosed in the summary; re-run -> 'update selection only' to change.
new_project only. existing_project: defaults + auto-check Jira/ClickUp/AWS when their signal is detected; disclosed in the summary.

options.label: Jira
options.auto_when: existing_project + Jira key in commits / .jira config

design_direction.note: Runs after the agent set is known, only if a UI agent (odin/vision) is active. Writes doc/brandpack.md (18-section design system) + doc/brand-previews/. Token sections concrete; component-implementation sections [TBD] in new_project until built.
design_direction.new_project: derive 3 distinct directions from goal/audience/tone -> write doc/brand-previews/option-{a,b,c}.html (self-contained style guides) -> SendUserFile all 3 -> AskUserQuestion: A / B / C / Skip -> iterate on the pick until approved -> keep as brand-preview.html, delete rejected. Skip -> tokens [TBD], policy sections stay.
design_direction.existing_project: reverse-engineer the token system + Known Issues from the code -> write doc/brandpack.md fully -> render ONE doc/brand-previews/brand-preview.html -> SendUserFile as FYI, do NOT wait -> iterate only if the user replies with a correction.

extended_topics.note: No longer questions in EITHER mode. new_project: doc/*.md fields ship as honest [TBD]. existing_project: each filled directly from its detection signal; becomes an ambiguity_gate question only if signals conflict or a value the code implies has no signal.

file_structure.detect: apps/+packages/ -> monorepo; frontend/+backend/ -> separated; single app -> flat

deployment.detect: vercel.json/netlify.toml/wrangler.toml/Dockerfile -> provider; .github/workflows/ or .gitlab-ci.yml -> CI; file names -> environments
deployment.written: regardless of whether Groot is active

auth.detect: next-auth/@auth/passport-*/sanctum/socialite/devise+omniauth dep + auth route names -> method + provider(s)

testing.detect: vitest/jest + supertest + playwright/cypress; phpunit/pest; pytest; rspec -> unit/integration/e2e. .env.testing / sqlite override -> test-DB isolation
testing.written: regardless of whether Hulk is active

credentials.collected: never — key names written as [PENDING] for every active skill that needs one; NickFury asks at first use

auto_accept_summary.note: existing_project only. After generation, print every auto-accepted value with the file/signal it came from. A reply naming a wrong value -> edit only that one doc/*.md field, re-print that line, do not re-run.
